name: Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center
notes: Researched from public mskcc.org pages: How to Pay Your Bill at MSK and Help With Your Financial Questions (no sign-in, no guest lookup). Pay online in MSK MyChart (Your Menu > Billing) or with Pay as Guest; enrollment in MSK MyChart is by email invitation from the care team (not self-service; the family registration form is kept, with a customer-facing note, and the gap is reported). Mail: Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, P.O. Box 24779, New York, NY 10087-4779. Phone: Patient Billing Services 646-227-3378, Mon-Fri 8-6 ET; include the medical record number (MRN) from the bill with every payment. Payment plans are set up through Patient Billing Services (phone), so payment_arrangement is modelled phone-only. Financial Assistance Program and prescription assistance; cost questions also by email. Guest lookup fields, online methods, fees, AutoPay and paperless are not described (family defaults kept).

help.title: How to pay your bill at MSK
paragraphs: Online: log in to MSK MyChart, select Your Menu at the top left, and choose Billing (or search the menu for it). No MSK MyChart account? Use Pay as Guest.
By mail: send your payment to Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, P.O. Box 24779, New York, NY 10087-4779.
By phone: call Patient Billing Services at 646-227-3378, Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Eastern time.
Include your medical record number (MRN), printed on your bill, with every payment.
steps: Select Your Menu at the top left.

help.title: Getting an MSK MyChart account
paragraphs: Enrollment starts with your care team. Tell them you would like to sign up for MSK MyChart, and they will send you an email invitation to create your account. Until then, you can pay with Pay as Guest.

help.title: Payment plans
paragraphs: Patient Billing Services can set up a payment plan and answer questions about your bill, your coverage or updating your insurance. Call 646-227-3378, Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Eastern.

help.title: Financial assistance
paragraphs: MSK has a Financial Assistance Program and prescription assistance programs for patients who need help paying for care. For questions about your bill or insurance, call Patient Billing Services at 646-227-3378.
